Name: Platonic Soulmates
Author: TimBukTw0
Description:
Platonic Soulmates
Have you ever gotten collector's anxiety and felt like you were missing out on items, events, and map elements that usually require marriage? Well, this mod is for you!

Platonic Soulmates adds a new item called the Merman Pendant, sold by the Old Mariner (or Older Mariner, depending on your config) upon reaching 8 hearts. Gifting one to a datable NPC will make you soulmates and unlock those final two friendship hearts — and don't worry, you can easily back out by lowering friendship points or gifting a Bouquet. Since this mod uses a fully custom heart system, there's no dating dialogue, only the friendship you already had  (though the occasional flirty line may still slip through!)
Custom events have been added to unlock all the cool items, events, and map elements locked behind relationships — no marriage required. This includes exclusive items your future spouse would normally make for you, map elements, and much more!
Once you hit that custom 10th heart, the Old Mariner will fish up that NPC's spouse portrait for you to collect. Now you don't have to break hearts to collect them all!
Compatible with all Datable NPCs (including modded) via a dynamic system, with custom platonic events available for ALL of Vanilla datables as well as planned SVE spouses (Victor already implemented)

Also included is a dynamic translation system — find the included en.json file and replace the dialogue with your translated lines (avoid changing anything that isn't plain text, as it may break things).
